instructions:
SMALL AND CONVENIENT: Speaker is compact and light, very light, allowing you to enjoy music anytime, anywhere.
SIMPLE OPERATION: With one click, you just click it then can answer calls, FM radio and play music.
MULTI-DEVICE COMPATIBLE: Compatible with most smartphones, tablets, and laptops and not worry to use.
WIDELY APPLICABLE SCENES: Good for coffee, minibar, small parties, car, outdoor activities and many other situations.
BEAUTIFUL: Bright color, shape is cute, and the mini is small, which can also play a decorative role.

COMPACT AND CONVENIENT: With a diameter of about 1.2 inches (slightly wider than a quarter) and a net weight of about 2.1 oz, this may be the smallest wireless speaker you'll ever set your eyes on. This mini bluetooth speaker can easily fit inside your pocket and even comes with a phone strap which makes it easy to carry around.
POWERFUL: For such a small portable speaker, you'll be surprised at the loudness, with a volume of over >90DB. The device has the latest Bluetooth V5.0 which produces crisp sound quality at a range of over 30 feet. As with other bluetooth devices, just make sure there are no big objects causing interference. The battery lasts about 2 hours on a full charge and comes with a short power cable for convenient charging.
UNIQUE FEATURES: Taking a photo with your phone can be cumbersome with just one hand. This compact speaker allows you to capture special moments with your phone camera, including selfies, with the speaker button using your free hand. You can also phone calls with the click of a button.
MAKES A GREAT GIFT: These compact wireless speakers are available in different colors and make a fun gift that your friends and loved ones will be able to use immediately, as indoor or outdoor speakers. If you are looking for bluetooth mini speakers and are on a budget, these are some of the best portable speakers you will ever try.
CONNECT TO BLUETOOTH IN SECONDS: The speaker has the latest Bluetooth version 5.0 and a range of 30+ feet, and is compatible with most devices that have bluetooth connection enabled such as iPhone, Samsung, iPad, Mac, Windows PC, or any smartphone or tablet for that matter.
Stylish and elegant, high, medium and low music are all very prominent from this speaker,exceptional quality.

Enjoy wireless streaming from your device with this Insignia portable Bluetooth speaker. Its rubberized feet keep it secure in both horizontal and vertical orientations, and it has a built-in speakerphone to keep you connected wherever you are. This Insignia portable Bluetooth speaker has a 12-hour battery life for uninterrupted listening.

【Long playtime & Endurance sound quality】: With quanlity bass effect and strong sound penetration, this speaker has special tuned stereo speaker provide HD sound quality, clear high frequency, powerful low frequency and warm vocal without distortion, also, long lasting playtime too. 【Waterproof,Portable & SUPER SUCTION】: - Resilient IPX6 construction protects this wireless speaker from dust, sand and water splash,also with accessories the hook,suction cup,no matter you are in the beach,showering or cycling,music is there for you in an arm's distance.(Note: please don’t immerse this device in liquid) 【COMPATIBLE WITH ALL BLUETOOTH DEVICE】:BT4.2 ensures instant pairing with all bluetooth devices like mobile phones, computers or tablets. 【Most Competitive price】:It's our pleasure to provide you with most competive price with good quality speakers. What will you get: 1 x Speaker 1 x USB Charging Cable 1 x User Manual Note: Your speaker will power off automatically within 30 minutes if you did not pair it with playback devices in order to save energy.

The Bell & Howell BH20TWS (True Wireless Stereo) Speaker can be used alone or paired with the built-in True Wireless Stereo technology to create up to 4 hours of rich, robust audio pleasure. The rugged and portable design is great for traveling and outdoor use. Features include, Bluetooth and Auxiliary connectivity, Built-in Lithium-Ion Rechargeable Battery, Built-in Micro SD Card Slot, Built-in Microphone, Easy Access Interface, and Powerful HD Sound.

Acoustic Research Portable Bluetooth Wireless Outdoor Flame Speaker - Santa Cruz Let the AR Santa Cruz Bluetooth Outdoor Flame Speaker be the life of your party! Pair two speakers together (sold separately) for a dynamic wireless stereo sound. The 30 watt, 2-way system plus enhanced bass radiator provides amazing audio performance. Bluetooth connectivity offers you the freedom to control and play music wirelessly from your smartphone or tablet up to 150 feet away, and the aux input gives you the option of a direct connection. It’s also IP55 Rated weather-resistant and perfect for any season. The Santa Cruz provides 360 degrees of multi-mode flame lighting in both white and blood orange – providing that lantern-like feel – so you can light up the night on your patio or deck. Now there’s no reason your party should stop when the sun goes down. Accessories Included: AC power adapter 3.5mm aux-in cable Features: Enjoy music wirelessly from your smartphone or tablet with Bluetooth Dynamic Audio - 30 watt, 2-way speaker system plus enhanced bass radiator Stereo Capable - pair two speakers together for dynamic wireless stereo sound (sold separately) 164 LEDs with 4 modes of lighting - Flame, Flicker, Pulse and White Listen up to 18 hours from the built-in lithium-ion rechargeable battery Up to 150 Ft. Bluetooth Range IP55 Rated Weather-resistant design Aux input for other wired sources Speaker Dimensions- 14.3” H x 10.7” W x 10.7” D

GREAT HI-FI SOUND: The Addon C10 is the heavy weight champion of multiroom hifi performance. Still compact and easy to place, but this speaker packs a real punch. This speaker is designed with one purpose in mind; to give you pure joy and entertainment.
MULTIROOM FLEXIBILITY: Have a speaker in every room and play to one or all at the same time. Everybody can play their personal music on which ever speaker they want.
PLAY ANYTHING WIRELESSLY: Just connect your turn table or CD-player to a C5 or C10 speaker, and let the sound stream wirelessly to all the speakers in your setup. Old School is the New Cool.
WIFI PRESETS - PLAY DIRECT: No need to start fiddling with your phone, just push and play. Save your favourite radio station or playlist to a button simply by pressing it while playing content. With Airplay, Spotify Connect and Bluetooth you can play all your music any way you like.
QUICK & EASY SETUP: Audio Pro App Connectivity! Simply connect it to your home Wifi network once and you're good to go. Add additional speakers over time.

Bright Max™ - INDOOR/OUTDOOR 360° SOUND BLUETOOTH°-ENABLED SPEAKER WITH LIGHTING AND MULTI-SYNC™Add Light, Style and 360˚ Premium Surround Sound Indoors and Outdoors—Wirelessly!You want to add just the right touch of style and lighting to your space. You also want great sounding, dynamic music. Bright Max™️ is the perfect answer! Bright Max™️ is a high-power 60-watt sound system that is IPX5 water-resistant, so it is safe to leave in the rain or near the pool. Get ready for any event by streaming and controlling your music wirelessly up to 100ft through any Bluetooth®️-enabled device. Thanks to our special 360˚ sound experience innovation, Bright Max™️ has premium surround sound allowing you to get great sound wherever you are - ideal for indoor and outdoor use! With 5 multi-color LED light modes, including a candle flicker effect, it is easy to create the perfect atmosphere for your gathering. When you are looking for a more relaxed setting, choose from the built-in atmospheric sounds where you can select from white noise, ocean, babbling brook and more. With a built-in rechargeable battery, Bright Max™️ can be used virtually anywhere. You can also control both the audio and lighting functions using the ION Sound XP™️ App with any iOS or Android device. Best of all, Bright Max™️ features our Multi-Sync™️ Technology, which enables you to easily control up to 100 ION Audio linked speakers to really amplify your outdoor sound experience and ambience.INDOOR/OUTDOOR 360° SOUND BLUETOOTH°-ENABLED SPEAKER WITH LIGHTING AND MULTI-SYNC™

SYN Portable Bluetooth Speaker with Customizable Color Bands This portable bluetooth audio speaker is perfect for on the go or at home. It can easily connect to any bluetooth enabled device including smartphones, tablets and more. With 8 color options and multiple (8) colored bands, you can fully customize your speaker the way you like it. This speaker is available in black, blue, green, pink, purple, red, white and yellow. The included extra interchangeable bands fit perfectly around the speaker. Specifications: Li-ion battery: 3.7V/500mAh USB charging voltage: DC 5V Speaker Type: Passive Speaker: 40mm 2.60hm 3W Frequency range: 60HZ~18KHZ Size: 60x60x53mm (2.36 x 2.36 x 2.08 in) In The Box: Super Bass Portable Bluetooth Speaker 8 Assorted Silicone Rubber Bands USB 2 in 1 Cable: 3.5mm & Micro USB for charging User Manual
